Project Memory

Source: MEMORY.md

Corrections and learned facts that persist across sessions for flightsbr. When a mistake is corrected, or a non-obvious approach is confirmed, append a [LEARN:category] entry below.

Prior content (inherited from the workflow template’s own development history, not about flightsbr) is archived at quality_reports/archive/inherited-template-memory.md.

[LEARN:anac] 2026-11: gov.br flights page links are relative (/anac/.../x.zip) and lead to an HTML landing page → resolve with rvest::url_absolute() and append /@@download/file. [LEARN:anac] sas.anac.gov.br (airfares) blocks bursts of scripted requests with an HTML “Requisição Bloqueada” page served as HTTP 200 → status codes alone don’t prove success; check content type / first bytes, keep max_active low. [LEARN:anac] 404s on sas/sistemas hosts still write the HTML error page to the paths= file in httr2::req_perform_parallel() → download to a temp .part file, rename only on success. [LEARN:anac] Airfare headers changed 5 times (ANO/TARIFA; Ano de Referência/Tarifa-N; designador_/VALOR_TARIFA; leading “” index col; nr_/sg_*), interleaved month by month, never reordered. 202005 is UTF-8, other Portuguese-header files Latin-1. Map by name (airfare_col_map), never by date. [LEARN:anac] RAB layout changed 2026-01→2026-03: MARCA→MARCAS; owner/operator columns became JSON arrays (restructured, not renamed). Every field is quoted, so fread’s na.strings does nothing and "" escapes are kept literally → clean after reading. [LEARN:anac] nr_* column names are not a numeric signal: movements nr_aeroporto_referencia = “SBAR”, RAB nr_serie = “LA-189”, flights nr_voo/nr_chave are IDs. Convert only if all values parse. [LEARN:anac] Private airports file writes coordinate seconds with a decimal comma (39,8"S) that parzer can’t read; ",0" is ANAC’s missing-altitude code.
